edges.label: AARO's case work does not address the domestic incursion wave
edges.note: Neither the published case slides nor the FY2025 report present an assessment of the Langley, New Jersey or Barksdale incursions, which are handled as a counter-UAS force-protection matter by NORTHCOM and JIATF-401 instead. Reasoning: absence across all published AARO products, not a stated jurisdictional ruling.
